manifest.state_model: In-memory incremental structures (adjacency, per-node canonical degree lists reproducing the C0 bincount degree bit for bit, component member lists, anchors, coordinates in a per-component frame read relative to its anchor). Additive deltas only. Every mutation is journaled and undone on refusal. Export/load produce and validate the canonical C0-format snapshot.
manifest.queue_order: Stable sorted node IDs within each active round; neighbors enter the next round; node-local C0 gradient steps (alpha = 0.25 / max(1, maximum weighted degree)) read the current workspace; nodes flagged by a failed certificate take one forced step
manifest.budget_scope: One 100,000-operation cap per transaction over every in-memory step: delta input records, degree-list upkeep, frame placement reads, frame translation writes, anchor candidates, incident-edge reads and certificate reads. A superset of edge visits. Export, load and evaluator work are timed separately.
manifest.certificate: Local and explicit: every node whose force may have changed (added-edge endpoints, new nodes, freed anchors, moved nodes, neighbors of moved nodes) must satisfy force, normalized-force and step tolerances times (1 - 1e-6). Loaded states are fully certified by the accepted C0 validator; rigid frame translations preserve old residuals and alpha cannot grow. The evaluator's reload re-validates every committed state globally.
manifest.fallback: Distinct arm: after the queue cap is exhausted, a separately capped (5,000,000 operations) Jacobi-preconditioned conjugate-gradient solve on the affected components, warm-started from the queue workspace, then the same certificate over those components. The queue arm runs with no fallback. Fallback commits are never counted as queue successes.
manifest.update_initialization: Every old component is a rigid frame and each added node a singleton frame. A spanning tree of added inter-frame constraints places frames; the largest frame (then smallest anchor ID) stays fixed and the others translate. Cycles and contradictions use the declared residual relaxation. No reference or truth access.
manifest.world_variation: Each seed draws grid widths, continuous position jitter, consistent chord cycles, intervention endpoints and the contradiction vector
manifest.controls: Third disconnected component is unaffected; distant connected nodes are potentially affected, never required to remain fixed; the frozen saved state answers every query as the no-update control
manifest.reference: Independent sparse anchored least squares (preconditioned conjugate gradients), qualified against independent dense LS at small sizes, built after both arms answered; compiled coordinates also measured. Fresh recompute time is the faster valid reference build.
manifest.endpoint_rules: H-L consistent additive in-memory updates: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE only if every locality kind commits in all worlds at 32 and 2048 nodes with median queue-arm operations at 2048 <= 2x the median at 32, and every speed-kind world at 2048 has in-memory update time < fresh recompute time; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED. H-L contradiction resolution by the local queue at >= 128 nodes: NOT_SUPPORTED if the queue-arm resolution rate < 0.5, SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE if 1.0, else INCONCLUSIVE. Durable persistence is global by design and not tested for locality.
manifest.acceptance: Each arm is reference-correct when committed or explicitly unresolved with byte-identical previous state and a proven cap exhaustion; budget, reference, retention, reload and determinism checks pass. Prior-state answers after a refusal are reported separately, never as coverage
manifest.claim_scope: 80 registered interventions, five seed-varied worlds per size/intervention, one generator family, unit weights in the panel (weighted, duplicate and tiny-weight cases are covered by focused checks)
manifest.registration_note: R004 implementation and endpoints were written after inspecting R002/R003 and one development smoke test on non-panel seed 7; they are evaluated only on the new seeds starting at 10,000,000
manifest.selection_rule: No tuning or adaptive selection after execution; all cases and all unresolved outcomes are retained

H-L.durable_persistence: NOT_TESTED: export/load are O(V+E) by design and reported separately

hypothesis_limits: H-L verdicts follow the registered endpoints within this generator family and in-memory transactions; export/load are global and reported separately. The speed endpoint compares with a fresh full recompute, not with an equally incremental compiled baseline, so no superiority over compiled methods is claimed. H-P: the frozen-versus-adaptive comparison is reported, but a store that includes new constraints answers them by construction; no task learning or transfer is tested.
